correctness.rationale: For symbolic base-b coding the forbidden holes are cylinders 00 and (b-1)(b-1). The source-proof update A_c maps a vector of ending-symbol counts to V except at the chosen endpoint, where it is V-v_endpoint. Positivity of the linear continuation functionals, plus exchanging endpoints, implies choosing the larger current endpoint count minimizes every remaining horizon and strictly wins if unequal. After the first deletion the opposite endpoint count is uniquely largest; hence unique strict alternation for n>=2. The alternating count satisfies A_(n+2)=b A_(n+1)-A_n, A0=b,A1=b²-1, including the b=2 repeated root and exact b>=3 roots. The fixed-hole characteristic polynomial has larger positive root, proving strict escape-rate advantage. Independent exhaustive enumeration of 2^n schedules for b=2..5 and n=1..7 checked equality and uniqueness; the monotone comparison proves all b,n.
residual_risks: No uniqueness asserted for infinite schedules sharing only the limiting escape exponent; time-dependent adaptive control not considered.
